daemon.description: Run httpry as a daemon process. Requires an output file.

interface.description: Ethernet interface to listen on. Defaults to system first found if empty.

output_file.description: Path to the output file for parsed HTTP data.

pid_file.description: Path and filename for the PID file in daemon mode.

user.description: Alternate user to take ownership of the process. Must be non-root if specified.

output_format.description: Comma-delimited string specifying parsed HTTP data fields to output.

http_methods.description: Comma-delimited list of request methods to parse. Empty means all standard RFC2616 methods.

quiet.description: Suppress non-critical output like startup banner and statistics.

packet_count.description: Number of HTTP packets to parse before exiting. 0 means loop forever.

ethernet_offset.description: Number of bytes to skip in the ethernet header.

pcap_output.description: Path to write processed HTTP packets to a binary pcap dump file.

capture_file.description: Path to an input capture file to read from instead of live capture.
